properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js is elliptic's hash backend, pulled in by @walletconnect/utils (relay-auth ES256) and the TronWeb-family SDKs. The repo's own source never calls it directly — the UI library delegates crypto to wallet SDKs — but the digests ship with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js's MD5 ships in the bundle; no call site found in this repo's own source (the app delegates crypto to wallet SDKs and injected wallets).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-1 available in the shipped crypto-js bundle; no call site in this repo's source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/poly1305@1.0.1 and @stablelib/chacha20poly1305@1.0.1 are resolved entries in pnpm-lock.yaml, transitive dependencies of the blockchain SDK stack. The Poly1305 MAC ships with the build; no direct application call site exists (verified: zero crypto-library imports in packages/*/src). Changeable here only via the SDK vendors' dependency updates.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The build ships secp256k1 ECDSA signing capability; the repo's demos and providers trigger it indirectly through ethers and injected wallets. Shor breaks this curve; the replacement (ML-DSA) is dictated by the chains and WalletConnect, not by this repo — observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey@1.0.3 — the OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF, the browserify-aes/crypto-browserify password-to-key path — is a resolved transitive dependency in pnpm-lock.yaml. Ships with the build; no direct application call site. Retroactive key-derivation risk if any dependency in the chain derives keys from passwords with it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real hardcoded credentials: the dumi docs-site define block hardcodes API keys for two blockchain RPC providers — ZAN (Ant Group's node service) and Infura — which the bundler substitutes into demo code as compile-time constants (e.g. docs/course/demos/solana-tx-without-wallet.tsx:16 builds the Solana devnet RPC URL from YOUR_ZAN_API_KEY). Committed bearer credentials, CWE-321; should be rotated and moved to environment variables. The same define block also carries a WalletConnect project ID and

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/ed25519@1.7.5 and @stablelib/ed25519@1.0.3 are resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml — Ed25519 signature capability shipping transitively via the blockchain SDK stack (@solana, @near-js, cosmos-adjacent packages). Shor-vulnerable. The one in-repo execution of ed25519 is via @solana/web3.js Keypair.generate/sendAndConfirmTransaction in docs/course/demos/solana-tx-without-wallet.tsx (reported as a separate finding).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Highest HNDL relevance in this repo: WalletConnect pairing traffic recorded today becomes readable once a CRQC exists. The key-agreement algorithm is fixed by the @walletconnect protocol libraries — replaceable only upstream (WalletConnect), observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: create-ecdh@4.0.4 (the crypto-browserify ECDH shim for Node's crypto.createECDH) is a resolved transitive dependency in pnpm-lock.yaml, part of the browserify crypto polyfill chain. Ships with the build; no direct application call site; ECDH key agreement is Shor-vulnerable if any dependency exercises it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature facet of the resolved tweetnacl@1.0.3 dependency (pnpm-lock.yaml), owned transitively by @near-js/crypto@0.0.3/0.0.4 and other chain SDKs; same dependency as LIB-0469707e. Shor-vulnerable signature capability shipping with the build; no direct application call site in first-party code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ECDSA capability ships in the build; invoked indirectly at runtime by the WalletConnect libraries. Signature scheme chosen upstream, observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 (tweetnacl crypto_box key agreement) facet of the resolved tweetnacl@1.0.3 dependency; same dependency as LIB-0469707e. Shor-vulnerable key-agreement capability shipping transitively; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Keccak-256 runs inside the ethers/walletconnect code whenever EVM addresses or signature hashes are computed. Fixed by the EVM protocol; observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (BIP39, 2048 iterations — fixed by the BIP39 standard, not tunable here) ships in the build via ethers; no direct call site in this repo's source.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@3.0.1 resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml — the scrypt password KDF (Ethereum-keystore-style key derivation) shipping transitively via the Ethereum SDK stack. No direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES capability of the resolved crypto-js@4.2.0 dependency (dep of merkletreejs→web3-utils, the web3.js stack); same dependency as LIB-5cc7b908. Ships with the build; no direct application call site. crypto-js 4.2.0 additionally carries MD5/SHA-1/DES/EVP_BytesToKey weak defaults — the weak-default surface of this legacy dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/chacha20poly1305@1.0.1 resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml — quantum-safe AEAD shipping transitively with the blockchain SDK stack. No direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (tweetnacl crypto_secretbox AEAD) facet of the resolved tweetnacl@1.0.3 dependency; same dependency as LIB-0469707e. Quantum-safe symmetric AEAD shipping transitively; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml — the Ed25519/X25519/SHA-512/XSalsa20-Poly1305 library shipping transitively via chain SDKs (@near-js/crypto and peers). The only in-repo execution path found is @solana/web3.js's Keypair.generate()/sendAndConfirmTransaction() in docs/course/demos/solana-tx-without-wallet.tsx, which generates and signs ed25519 locally through tweetnacl.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@4.2.0 resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml via merkletreejs→web3-utils (web3.js stack) — legacy JS crypto library providing AES, DES, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2 and PBKDF2 with weak defaults (single-round MD5 EVP_BytesToKey). Ships with the build; no direct application call site in first-party code.
